title: Fullstack Developer
description: We're scaling our product team and looking for a fullstack engineer who enjoys ownership end to end—from API design to polished UI. You'll join a fully distributed crew across LATAM with async-friendly rituals, code review culture, and room to influence architecture.
responsibilities: Design and implement features in NestJS services and PostgreSQL, with attention to migrations and performance.
Build and maintain React features with TypeScript, shared hooks, and accessible components.
Partner with product and design in discovery; break work into shippable increments with clear acceptance criteria.
Write automated tests (unit, integration, e2e where it pays off) and participate in on-call rotations lightly.
Contribute to our internal component library and API style guides so patterns stay consistent.
requirements: 4+ years shipping web applications; solid TypeScript on both client and server.
Experience with relational databases, migrations, and honest error handling in production.
Comfortable with GitHub Flow, CI, and reviewing others' code with constructive feedback.
English or Spanish for async written communication; overlap with team hours in Americas time zones.
benefits: Remote-first stipend for coworking and home office setup
Health coverage options and annual learning budget
Flexible PTO and company-wide recharge weeks
Equity participation depending on level and location

title: Backend Developer
description: Start your career in production systems with structured mentorship. You'll rotate through API development, observability, and database topics while shipping real changes to our customer-facing stack.
responsibilities: Implement features and fixes in Node services under review from senior engineers.
Learn to operate dashboards for logs, metrics, and traces; participate in incident retros.
Write tests and documentation so the next person understands your decisions.
Pair frequently in the first months; gradually take solo ownership of small vertical slices.
requirements: Computer science coursework or bootcamp plus personal or academic projects using JavaScript or Python.
Curiosity about HTTP APIs, SQL basics, and how deployments reach users.
Willingness to work onsite in our Mexico City office with hybrid flexibility after ramp-up.
Legally authorized to work in Mexico.
benefits: Mentorship program and dedicated learning days
Meals and transit support where applicable
Health insurance after probation
Clear growth path toward mid-level roles

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description: Our web app serves millions of sessions; performance, accessibility, and maintainability are the product. You'll set the bar for how we load data, structure routes, and ship UI that works for everyone.
responsibilities: Own complex flows in React—routing, caching, and optimistic updates with clear failure modes.
Drive Core Web Vitals and a11y fixes across squads; partner with design on tokens and motion.
Mentor engineers through design docs, pairing, and crisp code review.
Represent frontend in technical planning; flag risk early and propose incremental mitigations.
requirements: 6+ years of frontend engineering including large SPAs or hybrid SSR stacks.
Deep React experience and pragmatism about state and server data boundaries.
Demonstrated accessibility mindset (semantic HTML, keyboard flows, tooling).
Strong written communication for distributed collaboration.
benefits: Global remote with regionally competitive compensation
Annual conference and tooling budget
Parental leave and flexible scheduling
Stock options

title: Product Designer
description: You'll shape end-to-end journeys from problem framing to polished UI, working shoulder-to-shoulder with PM and engineering. We value systems thinking, crisp documentation, and validation with real usage data.
responsibilities: Lead discovery for major initiatives—interviews, journey maps, and lightweight prototyping.
Produce and maintain Figma libraries aligned with engineering components.
Run usability tests and translate findings into iterative improvements.
Facilitate workshops that align stakeholders without endless meetings.
requirements: 5+ years in product or UX design for digital products; portfolio with shipped work.
Comfortable facilitating research and presenting trade-offs with evidence.
Experience collaborating with engineers on accessible, responsive implementations.
Fluency in English; second languages a plus for our global users.
benefits: Hybrid studio days where hubs exist; remote otherwise
Design tooling budget (Figma, research tools)
Wellness stipend and generous PTO
Stock options

responsibilities: Deliver customer-facing flows in React 18 with TanStack Query and a growing design system.
Collaborate on API contracts with backend peers; handle edge cases in the UI honestly.
Improve test coverage and storybook examples for tricky components.
Participate in squad rituals: planning, retro, and occasional production support.

Solid understanding of async data, caching, and error states in SPAs.
Experience with Git-based workflows and CI pipelines.

title: Backend Engineer

responsibilities: Design and implement Go services with clear APIs and observability hooks.
Operate Kafka (or similar) pipelines with backpressure and replay in mind.
Evolve PostgreSQL schemas with zero-downtime migration discipline.
Share on-call with strong runbooks; learn from incidents, not blame.

Experience with distributed systems concepts: at-least-once delivery, idempotency, partitions.
Comfortable in Linux environments, containers, and Kubernetes basics.
Professional working English; hybrid presence in Spain as agreed with your team.

Learning budget and conference attendance

responsibilities: Own GitHub Actions pipelines and artifact promotion strategies across environments.
Maintain Terraform modules for AWS footprint; review changes with platform peers.
Roll out OpenTelemetry standards and dashboards that teams actually use.
Partner with product engineering on safe releases: flags, canaries, rollbacks.

Strong Terraform and AWS experience; IaC review habits.
Solid scripting (Python, Bash, or Go) for glue and automation.
EU timezone alignment; occasional travel for team summits.

title: Data Analyst
description: Help teams see the story in their numbers. You'll build dashboards, defend metric definitions, and dig into SQL when executives ask questions that don't fit a template.
responsibilities: Maintain BI dashboards; ensure filters and definitions match business intent.
Write clear SQL for ad-hoc analysis; document assumptions so numbers are reproducible.
Partner with ops and product to improve event tracking and data quality.
Present insights succinctly; visualize so stakeholders grasp trade-offs quickly.
requirements: 1–3 years in analytics or a strong analytical degree with internship experience.
Proficiency in SQL; exposure to a major BI stack (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar).
Comfort with spreadsheets, basic statistics, and sanity-checking outliers.
Spanish professional proficiency; Buenos Aires onsite with hybrid options.
benefits: Health plan and meal allowances per local norms
Training in SQL and modern BI tooling
Career path toward data science or analytics engineering
Flexible hours around core collaboration windows
